column1: # Files kept under /tmp: .t27 spec pins (sha256) and explicit tri fpga-keep trees,
# each as blobs/<file sha256> (gitignored). Written by tri fpga-tmpcheck --archive
# and tri fpga-keep, not by hand. pinned_by is spec:CONST or keep:TAG; +payload
# means the pin is the .bit's payload from the sync word, not the whole file.
